issues.summary: Container PSSU4527862 (HBL MFCIM260009) incurred demurrage from 17 March 2026 after Pacific Star declined a late free-time extension request, invoiced at 4 days totalling USD 1,120.
Blue Harbor Foods requested a pick-up hold of about a week for PSSU4527862 because their cold storage warehouse was full.

decisions.summary: Pacific Star Shipping declined the 5-day free-time extension for PSSU4527862 because the request arrived on the expiry day rather than before it.
Meridian absorbs 50% (USD 560) of the USD 1,120 demurrage on PSSU4527862 and bills the remaining USD 560 to Blue Harbor Foods.

tasks.summary: Send Bora Jung a settlement letter explaining the 50/50 split of the USD 1,120 demurrage.
Book Meridian's USD 560 share of the demurrage for PSSU4527862.
Arrange pick-up of PSSU4527862 as soon as possible to stop demurrage accruing.

deadlines.what: Pacific Star free time (10 days) for container PSSU4527862 expires.
